## Install

Requires macOS 13 or later. The ZIP supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

1. Download `Share-Slice-VERSION.zip` from the assets below, then unzip it.
2. Drag **Share Slice.app** to **Applications** and open it.
3. This build is ad hoc signed, without an Apple Developer ID or notarization.
   If macOS blocks it, open **System Settings > Privacy & Security** and choose
   **Open Anyway** after trying to launch it. Only allow it if you trust this download.
   See [Apple's instructions](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445).
4. Start capture and grant Screen Recording access when prompted. Reopen the app
   if macOS requests it.
5. In your meeting app, share the **Meeting Share Window** window.

Download the app ZIP, not GitHub's source-code archives. Xcode isn't needed to run it.
